steps.title: Know where they are
steps.say: Woodland mansions are in [dark forests](biome:dark_forest) and [pale gardens](biome:pale_garden). They are rare, and often thousands of blocks away.

steps.title: Get a map
steps.say: A master cartographer villager sells a map to a woodland mansion for [emeralds](item:emerald) and a [compass](item:compass).

steps.title: Follow the map
steps.say: Hold the map and walk until your marker reaches the mansion mark. It is a long trip, so bring food.

steps.title: Get ready to fight
steps.say: [Vindicators](mob:vindicator) swing [axes](item:wooden_axe), and [evokers](mob:evoker) send flying [vexes](mob:vex). Wear armor and bring a [shield](item:shield).

steps.title: Look around inside
steps.say: Mansions have many rooms, with [chests](item:chest) and sometimes [allays](mob:allay) in cages.

steps.title: Win a totem
steps.say: [Evokers](mob:evoker) drop a [totem of undying](item:totem_of_undying). Hold it, and it saves you once from dying.
